explain.say: Let's put on a shadow puppet show! You hold a 10 centimetre card puppet half a metre from the wall, and shine a torch. Look at the bars on the board: they show how tall the shadow is as you move the torch. Let's find out how to make a giant!

faq.a: Light travels in straight lines. When an opaque object blocks the light, a dark area with no light forms behind it on the ground or wall. That dark area is a shadow.

faq.q: How do you make a shadow bigger?
faq.a: Move the light closer to the object, or move the object closer to the light. The object blocks more of the light, so the shadow grows.
asks: How do I make a giant shadow?

faq.q: Why does a shadow get smaller when the torch moves away?
faq.a: Far from the torch, the light rays reaching the object are nearly side by side, so the object blocks only a narrow band of light and the shadow is close to the object's real size.

faq.q: Why is a shadow the same shape as the object?
faq.a: Because light travels in straight lines, the light that just misses the edges of the object marks out its outline on the wall.
asks: Why do shadows have the same shape?

faq.q: Can a shadow be smaller than the object?
faq.a: With a small torch, a shadow on a wall behind the object is always at least as big as the object. With a large light source, the dark middle of a shadow can be smaller, with a fuzzy edge around it.

facts: Shadows form because light travels in straight lines and cannot pass through opaque objects.
With a small light source, the shadow's height equals the object's height times (torch-to-wall distance ÷ torch-to-object distance).

quiz.say: You want a huge shadow of your hand. What should you do with the torch?
quiz.show: For a huge shadow, move the torch…
quiz.why: A torch closer to your hand makes it block more light, so the shadow grows.

wrong.1: Moving the torch away makes the shadow smaller.
wrong.2: Light behind the wall cannot reach your hand at all.

quiz.say: Why does an opaque puppet make a shadow?
quiz.show: A puppet makes a shadow because…
quiz.why: The puppet blocks the light, leaving a dark patch behind it.

wrong.1: Nothing makes darkness; a shadow is just where light cannot reach.
wrong.2: Reflecting light does not explain the dark patch behind it.
